Chapter 288: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: My dear disciple, your question is a bit beyond the scope… (Please subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

In the Central Divine China World, after hundreds of years of development, and with his personal guidance, there were only that many Martial Dao Cultivators.

However, in the Main World, in just a few years, the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries had reached such a scale.

In terms of growth speed, the Main World far exceeded the Central Divine China World.

Lin Yuan wasn’t surprised by this, as the external conditions for cultivating were definitely better in the Main World than in the Central Earth World.

After all, all kinds of high technology and the existence of High-Rank Evolvers made the act of cultivating quite simple.

...

In addition,

Lin Yuan’s perfection of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and the Chikun Evolution Rankings reaching the twelfth place were also significant factors in the explosive growth in the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries.

“It’s still too few.”

“Need to speed it up a bit.”

After considering for a while, Lin Yuan decided to record a video to specifically discuss issues regarding Martial Dao cultivation.

He had wanted to do this for a long time, but had never had the time.

Now that he had finished his journey through the worlds, he could start on this task.

As the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Martial Dao was unquestionably the best in the Main World. His cultivation analysis videos would have an effect on other Martial Arts Evolutionaries similar to an enlightenment.

…

In the Chikun Prime Virtual World, Central Plaza Area.

Numerous Evolvers gathered here, and within the Human Alliance, most Evolvers as well as higher-level citizens lived leisurely.

The strength of Human Civilization and victory in wars against outsiders benefited all of the Human Race.

“The twelfth place in the Chikun Evolution Rankings… Just a Fifth Rank Evolution Path is enough to reach twelfth place. If it were to advance to the Sixth Rank Evolution Path, what then?”

Ever since the Martial Path Evolutionary Path appeared in the Chikun Evolution Rankings, the topics discussed in the Central Plaza Area mostly revolved around the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

It couldn’t be helped.

Compared to other Evolution Paths that hadn’t budged in hundreds of years, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was extravagantly exaggerated; it was hard not to pay attention.

“A Sixth Rank Evolutionary Path? That can’t be so easy, can it? Even for Scholar Yuan, developing the Sixth Rank Chapter of the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path would take some deep contemplation, wouldn’t it?”

An Evolver couldn’t help but speak out.

The potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was now too high, and correspondingly, the difficulty of developing the Sixth Rank Chapter was extraordinarily tough.

The higher one went, the more difficult it became to advance further.

For Scholar Yuan, developing the Sixth Rank Chapter of an Evolution Path was not a difficult task.

But that referred to ordinary Fifth Rank Evolution Paths.

Was the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path still considered an ordinary Fifth Rank Evolution Path?

To develop the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path without compromising standards likely was more difficult than developing the Seventh Rank Chapter of other Evolution Paths.

“That’s not necessarily true.”

Another Evolver joined the conversation.

He had watched the ranking rise of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, and it had all been in plain sight.

Every time before the Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s ranking improved, there was a whole bunch of people shouting that it was absolutely impossible.

But in the end?

Didn’t they all get a slap in the face?

So now, many Evolvers had become wise and would not prematurely state their opinions.

To avoid getting a slap in the face.

“However, to be fair, developing the Sixth Rank Chapter is not an easy task. The starting point of the Martial Dao is now too high…”

A few Evolvers, after observing for a while, couldn’t help but speak up.

Just then,

The time had reached the early morning.

The rankings in the Chikun Evolution Rankings began to ‘update’.

The names of a hundred Evolution Paths blurred for a moment.

Then quickly became clear.

“Holy shit.” An Evolver lost control of his emotions.

Other Evolvers looked up, their expressions extremely complicated, with shock, with inevitability, with disbelief, with how could it be?

Because the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, formerly ranked twelfth, had disappeared.

In its place was the Evolution Path that had been ranked eleventh.

As for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, it had moved into the top ten, to be precise, the sixth place.

“Breaking into the top ten?”

“And it’s the sixth?”

“That’s too quick.”

“Has the Sixth Rank Chapter been updated?”

The numerous Evolvers started discussing in low voices.

Most of the Evolvers, having experienced the previous ‘leaps’ of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, had already become somewhat immune.

But there were still some newcomers among the Evolvers, their faces full of shock, as this was a change in the top ten rankings of the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

“Let me see, what qualitative changes Scholar Yuan’s Sixth Rank Chapter involves.”

An Evolver immediately purchased the contents of the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Before posting the Sixth Rank Chapter, Lin Yuan priced this chapter at fifty billion.

However, to many powerful Evolvers, fifty billion was trivial, the potential of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was so great that spending fifty billion to purchase the Sixth Rank Chapter was completely worth it.

Perhaps through this Sixth Rank Chapter, they could have a breakthrough in their own cultivated Evolution Path, something that no amount of civilization currency could buy.

“The Sixth Rank Chapter, in addition to the life metamorphosis and significant enhancements to the Physical Body, Primordial Spirit, and Soul, also explores the Physical Body to a deeper extent and holds the promise of giving birth to Physical Body Divine Skills?”

“Physical Body Divine Skills? Can we, the Human Race, also have such talents like those Different Species?”

“So that’s how it is. Deep within human bloodlines, there are many pieces of information and abilities.”

“These informational abilities are extremely rare, and theoretically, they should never manifest.”

“But the Sixth Rank Chapter of Martial Dao actually uses some special method to amplify the information abilities deep within the bloodline…”

“This is too incredible.”
